verdict.rationale: Turso documents a Platform API for managing databases, groups, organizations and tokens, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. llms.txt and markdown docs are LLM-readable documentation, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
